text:
nora: Heads-up  customer 'blue-analytics' is reporting ~9.7k fewer embeds in our billed export vs their SDK logs for 2025-06-10. Can someone confirm?

billing-bot: automated alert: reconcile-delta detected for customer blue-analytics 2025-06-10; delta -9.7%. Ticket INC-2100 created.

kevin-sdk: tagging in  we released SDK 3.0.0 yesterday with a change to the idempotency key. We now derive X-Embed-Id as sha256(payload || truncated_timestamp) which can collapse distinct client batches that use identical payloads sent inside the same second. Not expected for batched telemetry.

omar: quick ledger check:

SELECT sum(embed_count) FROM ingest_ledger WHERE customer_id='blue-analytics' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-06-10T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-06-10T23:59:59Z';

Result: 90,300 billed. Expected per client samples: ~100,000. Delta = 9,700 embeds (~9.7%). Missing window shows many identical payloads deduped.

sara: finance stance: vendor-caused undercounts => credit + remediation. Amount estimate: 9,700 * $0.0004 = $3.88 -> round $3.88. I'll prepare manual credit FIN-4022 and add invoice memo. Legal not required for this magnitude.

kevin-sdk: immediate actions: 1) revert idemp change in SDK 3.0.1 and publish migration note 2) add X-SDK-Version header so dedupe can be scoped by sdk+customer 3) provide opt-out to preserve legacy UUID behavior. Posting PR to devex now.

nora: ops plan: we'll snapshot raw events and run a sandbox replay to produce a reconciliation report for the customer. We will not modify issued invoices; we'll credit now and supply the replay report for their validation.

sara: filed credit FIN-4022: $3.88. Memo: "Credit for embed undercount due to SDK idempotency-key change (2025-06-10)." Notifying account team and support.

kevin-sdk: uploaded sandbox replay artifacts s3://forensics/blue-analytics/2025-06-10-replay.tar.gz and will attach reconciliation CSV.
nora: added runbook item to require scoped dedupe (include customer_id + X-SDK-Version) and test harness to catch these regressions.
sara: credit applied and customer notified. Closing finance loop. :white_check_mark:

nora: Thanks all  eng/devex to follow-up with postmortem in incidents. Closing thread.
